recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴組織內大量擴大的濾泡（A，紅圈），高倍濾泡內由中到大型細胞取代正常生發中心結構（B、C）；免疫染色中濾泡內細胞呈強核陽性（E，符合 MUM1/IRF4）且增生指數高（H），FISH 顯示分離訊號（I，紅綠分開），是 IRF4 重排大 B 細胞淋巴瘤早期的濾泡型分布。
features: A: low-power section of lymphoid tissue with numerous closely packed, expanded follicle-like nodules (red circle marks area magnified)
B-C: follicles populated by medium to large cells with vesicular nuclei, lacking polarization and tingible body macrophages, rimmed by small lymphocytes
D: immunostain negative in follicles with positivity in surrounding mantle/interfollicular cells
E: strong diffuse nuclear positivity within follicular cells (pattern consistent with MUM1/IRF4)
F-G: additional unlabeled immunostains, one largely negative and one with cytoplasmic/membranous positivity in follicles; H: high nuclear proliferation index within follicles
I: interphase FISH with separated red and green signals (break-apart) alongside fused yellow signals, indicating a gene rearrangement
describe_en: Composite figure. Low-power H&E (A) shows lymphoid tissue with numerous expanded follicular nodules, and higher power (B-C) shows follicles effaced by medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, lacking normal germinal center polarity and tingible body macrophages. Immunostains (D-H; antibody labels not shown on the figure) highlight strong nuclear positivity within the follicular population in a pattern consistent with MUM1/IRF4, with a high proliferation index confined to the nodules, while the surrounding compartment is highlighted by a separate marker. Break-apart FISH (I) shows split red and green signals indicating rearrangement. Findings are consistent with an early follicular (intrafollicular) pattern of large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement; exact stain identities require the original legend.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers show polarization, tingible body macrophages and are MUM1 weak/negative in most centroblasts with BCL2-negative germinal centers and no IRF4 rearrangement.
PTFL shows expanded serpiginous follicles of blastoid cells but is MUM1 negative and lacks IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma grade 3B / FL with BCL2 rearrangement
ddx.vs: Conventional FL is usually BCL2 positive with t(14;18) and centrocytic background, whereas IRF4-rearranged LBCL is strong MUM1 positive and typically lacks BCL2 rearrangement.
DLBCL NOS shows diffuse sheets without the site/age profile and IRF4 break-apart; FISH for IRF4 is the discriminator.

stain: H&E; IHC (unlabeled, incl. MUM1-pattern); FISH: IRF4
